start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:read-my-device-notices with database <the name of my own account database>, device_id <this device's id> and after 0."
no_lists_because: The notices are rows of the person's own database; this workflow reads them there and names no list of its own.
instructions: 1. Name the database your account keeps its rows in, and the id of the device that reads.
2. Say "Run workflow:read-my-device-notices" with database, device_id and the cursor the device kept (after).
3. The first run makes the devices and notices tables when they are absent; a run where they exist changes nothing.
4. The device keeps the cursor the answer gives; nothing is written.

worked_examples.title: Read my notices for this device
worked_examples.ask: What is ready for my phone after notice 0?
worked_examples.given: The notice table holds told:1 addressed to this device, made after the device registered.
worked_examples.hands_back: notices with one entry, told:1, and a cursor of 1; said "1 notice is ready for this device, oldest first.".
